mainImage.alt: Wide shot of abandoned cars scattered across a dusty field with personal belongings and debris at the Nova music festival site near Re'im, Israel
mainImage.caption: Abandoned cars, personal belongings, and debris at the site of the Nova music festival in Re'im, Israel, on October 12, 2023, days after Hamas fighters killed 364 people at the open-air festival near the Gaza border.

body.caption: Abandoned cars, personal belongings, and debris at the site of the Nova music festival in Re'im, Israel, on October 12, 2023, days after Hamas fighters killed 364 people at the open-air festival near the Gaza border.

body.alt: Israeli AH-64 Apache helicopter flying over open terrain near the Gaza border firing defensive flares
body.caption: An Israeli AH-64 Apache attack helicopter fires flares near the Gaza border in October 2023. Israeli helicopters were later reported to have fired on civilians at the Nova music festival during the October 7 attack.
body.credit: Getty Images via The War Zone

body.alt: Israeli Apache helicopter firing a missile with smoke trail seen from ground near the Israel-Gaza border
body.caption: An Israeli Apache helicopter fires a missile toward Gaza on May 14, 2024. Israeli attack helicopters were reported to have fired on civilians at the Nova festival during the October 7, 2023 attack under the Hannibal Directive.
